scenes.setting: Street preaching about the coming apocalypse and the Creator's sanctuary; Klein refuses to be recruited and walks on past whole clusters of laid-off workers being consoled by strangers — deciding to hand it all to the Machinery Hivemind
scenes.text_anchor: “I don’t know, and I don’t want to know!”

scenes.setting: Bravehearts Bar at noon: Kaspars Kalinin is dead, 'suffocated in his own bedding' — the Rose School venting — and the new dealer in Billiard Room 3 is Ian, back from Pritz Harbor, who gives two free answers: nobody can find any believer of The Fool, and the bounty on Azik Eggers was posted by MI9

In the rental carriage, mourning the loss of the only Beyonders he could speak to unmasked — until Sharron is simply sitting opposite him in her Gothic dress ('I'll knock on the window next time'), reports the High-Sequence Beyonder gone, warns that the Primordial Moon and the Chained God are enemies, and answers the real question: yes, she knows where a Human-skinned Shadow characteristic is
scenes.text_anchor: “Miss Sharron, do you always appear all of a sudden like this?”
